slides: The trick that kills / "I'll do it tomorrow" ✍️
① Decide / WHEN and WHERE / first
② Write it as: / "When X, / I'll do Y"
③ Example: / "After brushing / my teeth, I'll / learn 5 words"
Tired of your phone / getting in the way? / Search "Lock Do it" / on the App Store 🔍
